units.source_text: 源氏逝世之后，住在六条院内的诸夫人，都啼啼哭哭地退出，各自迁居到预定的住处。

en.t: After Genji passed away, the ladies who had lived within the Rokujo estate all withdrew in tears and each moved to the residence that had been arranged for her.

units.source_text: 花散里夫人迁入源氏作为遗产分给她的二条院东院。

en.t: Lady Hanachirusato moved into the eastern wing of Nijo-in, which Genji had left to her as part of his estate.

units.source_text: 尼僧三公主迁入朱雀院分给她的三条宫邸。

en.t: The Third Princess, now a nun, moved into the Sanjo mansion that Suzaku-in had assigned to her.

units.source_text: 明石皇后则常住在宫中。

en.t: Empress Akashi, meanwhile, lived chiefly in the palace.

units.source_text: 因此六条院内人口稀少，十分冷静。

en.t: As a result, the Rokujo estate had few people left in it and became very quiet.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣说：“据我所见所闻别人家的事例，自古以来，凡主人在世时费尽心思建造的住宅，主人死后必然被人抛舍，荒废殆尽。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, said, "From what I have seen and heard in other families, since ancient times a residence that its master labored over while alive is inevitably abandoned after his death and falls completely into ruin.

units.source_text: 此种人世无常之相，实在伤心惨目。

en.t: Such a sight of the impermanence of human life is truly heartbreaking and painful to behold.

units.source_text: 故至少在我住世期间，定要使这六条院不致荒废，务使近旁的大路上人影不绝。”

en.t: Therefore, at least while I am still alive, I am determined not to let this Rokujo estate decay, and to keep people constantly passing along the broad road nearby."

units.source_text: 就请一条院的落叶公主迁入六条院，住在花散里的故居东北院中。

en.t: He therefore invited Princess Ochiba of Ichijo-in to move into the Rokujo estate and live in the northeast wing, Hanachirusato's former residence.

units.source_text: 他自己隔日轮流住宿六条院与三条院，每处每月住十五天。

en.t: He himself stayed on alternate days at Rokujo-in and Sanjo-in, spending fifteen days each month at each place.

units.source_text: 云居雁便与落叶公主平分秋色，相安无事。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari and Princess Ochiba thus stood on equal footing and lived together peacefully without incident.
